notes.title: Update for 2.1
notes.content:
The new build is version 2.1 just in time for the first anniversary of the Steam Release. Except for replacement of some missing voice lines, there are no changes to the actual 2.0 game itself. 

What there is, is a replacement of the character of Rachel. She appeared in other games as a Vicky 4.2 character, but her change to Gen 8.1 did not go as well as I'd hope. She looked older than 20 years old, and the hair style didn't fit her head very well. 

I upgraded Rachel to a Gen 9 character and gave her a better hair style, and replaced all the 110 images she is in.

notes.title: Ariane in Paradise 2.0
notes.content:
Version 2.0 is Live!

This summer I needed to improve my Daz Studio skills, and noticed [i][b]Ariane in Paradise[/b][/i] was looking old and dated, so I decided to update all the graphics of [i][b]Ariane in Paradise[/b][/i] to the Daz Engine.  The new graphics look better than any of my other games.

    [olist]
[*] Updated to Daz Studio 4.23 creating new Genesis 8.1 models for Ariane, Rachel, the Male and Female player characters, and many other characters from the game
[*] Rerendered all the images mostly with HDRI graphics, I was able to use the old sets except the hotel set, so had to build some new sets to replace the hotel.
[*] All the images are 2560x1440, a huge increase from the old 1080p graphics.
[*] Voice, sound effects, and Spanish translation have all been updated where there are changes.
[/olist]
